name: Consistencia de Accesorios
description: Analiza la consistencia de accesorios visibles en video para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Accessory Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes temporal consistency of accessories (glasses, earrings, hats) across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **Accessory Detección & Seguimiento**: Facial landmarks and object detection are used to identify accessories in each frame — glasses frames, earring positions, hat contours, and other wearable items. Each accessory is tracked across consecutive frames using optical flow and bounding box correlation.

2. **Geométrico Consistencia Análisis**: The geometric properties of detected accessories (shape, aspect ratio, symmetry) are measured per frame. In authentic video, accessories maintain consistent geometry modulated only by smooth head pose changes. Deepfakes often produce frame-to-frame geometric fluctuations in accessories due to imperfect face-swapping at boundaries.

3. **Textura & Appearance Estabilidad**: Accessory surface textures (reflective properties of glasses lenses, metallic sheen of jewelry) are tracked. Real accessories show physically coherent appearance changes with lighting. Deepfake generators frequently fail to maintain consistent accessory rendering, producing flickering or morphing artifacts.

4. **Límite Coherencia Check**: The edges where accessories meet skin/hair are examined. Authentic boundaries show consistent occlusion relationships and natural blending. Face-swap artifacts typically produce irregular boundary rendering — glasses frames may partially merge with skin, or earrings may appear to clip through hair.

5. **Temporal Anomalía Puntuación**: Statistical measures of accessory consistency (variance of geometric features, temporal gradient of appearance) are computed. High variance or sudden discontinuities across otherwise smooth motion sequences indicate manipulation, yielding an elevated forensic score.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante accessory consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
